messages:
Alice: Rolling out v2026.03.23-rc5 as a micro-sweep (7%) to EU-WEST + AP-SOUTH now. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.03.23-rc5
DeployBot: deploy started: v2026.03.23-rc5 -> traffic=7% regions=[eu-west, ap-south] by segment micro-sweep id=swp-176111
Ben: +1. Watching latency dashboards. Can someone confirm kv-cache warmup is enabled for this rollout? 
Carla: kv-cache = enabled for rc5. Batching profile = small-contiguous. 
Diego: seeing a small bump in 95p latency on eu-west edge (from 120ms -> 180ms) over the last 2 mins. Not huge but notable. @SRE-Oncall pls advise
SRE-Oncall: noted. Pulling traces now. Any error spike? 
Diego: error rate still within baseline but tail latency correlated with longer model init on a subset of pods. Possibly adapter cold-starts.
Ben: can we pause the sweep until we validate cold-start mitigations? If we continue we risk impacting a few customers.
Alice: suggest pause, pin existing variant for eu-west while we debug. We have a fast rollback path. 
Carla: quick check: rollout supports region pinning. Command: ``/deploy pause swp-176111 --region eu-west``
DeployBot: acknowledge: pausing sweep swp-176111 for region eu-west. traffic now: eu-west=0%, ap-south=7% -> global~3.5%
Diego: verified traffic shift. eu-west pinned to v2026.03.22-stable. No user-facing 5xx reported.
SRE-Oncall: traces show KV cache misses on adapter init. Recommend a warmup job and temporary prefetch setting: set PREFETCH=1 for rc5 in eu-west then resume. 
Alice: ok run warmup and set PREFETCH=1. Who will execute? 
Ben: I'll run the warmup script and bump PREFETCH. Doing now.
Ben: running: ``scripts/warmup.sh --region eu-west --model rc5``
DeployBot: warmup job started job=warmup-176111-euw
Ben: PREFETCH set. warmup completed. verified KV hit ratio improved from 0.42 -> 0.91
Carla: great. any objections to resuming micro-sweep at 7%? 
Diego: no objections from infra. Recommend ramping back slowly: 3% -> 7% over 5m.
Alice: agreed. Resume with ramp plan. Command: ``/deploy resume swp-176111 --ramp 3,7 --region eu-west``
DeployBot: resuming sweep swp-176111: eu-west ramp=3%->7% over 5m; ap-south remains 7%
SRE-Oncall: monitoring. I'll call if any regressions. 
Carla: added a temporary metric alert to watch kv-cache miss rate and 95p latency in eu-west.
Ben: metric feed looks healthy at 3%. 95p back to 130ms.
Diego: at 5% now, still stable.
Alice: at 7% eu-west now. Thanks all. Let's keep the pin available for 30m in case of regression. Release notes updated with the PREFETCH workaround.
Carla: noted. I'll update the changelog: "rc5: PREFETCH prefetch warmup to reduce cold-start latency".
DeployBot: sweep complete: swp-176111 -> rollout 7% active, regions=[eu-west, ap-south]. If you need to abort: ``/deploy rollback swp-176111``
Ben: thanks. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then remove the temporary alert.
SRE-Oncall: LGTM. No further action unless alerted. :thumbsup:
